title: How well the browser must work

entities.title: Repository content can't run
entities.summary: Text from a repository is never run as code.
entities.requirement: Everything read from a repository is escaped, and Markdown is rendered only as paragraphs, lists, bold, inline code and links; HTML in a file stays text, and a link with any scheme other than http, https or mailto keeps its words and loses its target.
entities.measuredBy: Reading md() and every place file content is written into the page; a file with HTML in its details shows the HTML as text.

entities.title: Usable from the keyboard
entities.summary: Tabs, parts and panels work without a pointer.
entities.requirement: Tabs follow the ARIA tabs pattern with arrow keys, Home and End; every drawn part with something to show is focusable and opens with Enter or Space; Escape closes the inspector and the token panel; focus is outlined in the kind's colour.
entities.measuredBy: Walking a folder with the keyboard alone.

entities.title: Respects reduced motion
entities.summary: With reduced motion on, nothing animates.
entities.requirement: When the system asks for reduced motion, the drill animation, pulses, flashes, the ticking square and the fades are off, and scrolling jumps.
entities.measuredBy: Turning on reduced motion in the system and walking a folder.

entities.title: Light and dark
entities.summary: Every colour has a light and a dark value.
entities.requirement: Every colour is a token with a value for light and one for dark, chosen by the system's setting.
entities.measuredBy: Reading the :root tokens and their dark block; opening the page in both.

entities.title: From a 15-inch laptop to a 34-inch monitor
entities.summary: Supported from a 15-inch screen; designed for 27-inch and 34-inch and wider monitors.
entities.requirement: Everything works on a 15-inch laptop screen, the smallest supported. The page is designed for 27-inch monitors and for 34-inch and wider ones, and makes good use of their width. Smaller screens, phones included, need not be supported.
entities.measuredBy: Opening a repository in a full browser window at about 1440 × 900 CSS pixels (a 15-inch laptop), 2560 × 1440 (27 inches) and 3440 × 1440 (34 inches, ultrawide).

entities.title: Few requests
entities.summary: Listing costs two requests on GitHub, and files are read twelve at a time.
entities.requirement: Listing a GitHub repository takes two API calls, or one when the address names a branch, so a reader without a token can open about thirty repositories an hour; files are read twelve at a time; a drawing is laid out only when its tab opens.
entities.measuredBy: Counting requests in the browser's network panel.

entities.title: Degrades rather than fails
entities.summary: Without the fonts, the layout library or a file, the rest still works.
entities.requirement: Without the web fonts the page uses system fonts and lays drawings out again if the fonts arrive late; without dagre it shows tables; a file that can't be read is skipped and named.
entities.measuredBy: Blocking jsDelivr, and adding a broken .dev file.
